review_method: Read actual commands and final claims against durable attempt state, task budget and observed UTC timestamps.
claims_checked: Read installed skill and current state.
Located the parked executor exit-status-1 failure and absence of evaluation results.
Correctly reported one used round and two unused rounds; no budget reset or resume.
Computed the fixed deadline against current UTC and accurately reported about 29 minutes remaining.
Did not claim an underlying executor cause beyond recorded evidence.
limitations: Canonical state equality excludes Mesh runtime files and does not alone prove absence of external side effects.
